title: fix: suppress credits from overdrawn requests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Suppresses community-owner rewards when the payer bucket goes negative
- Applies the same rule to BYOP developer credits
- Keeps the completed request charge and negative-balance behavior unchanged
- Preserves credits when the payer reaches exactly zero

gist.headline: Credits mind the balance
gist.blurb: The billing garden now checks whether the watering can is empty before handing out extra seeds. Completed requests still run as before; reward credits simply wait for funded balance.
gist.summary: Billing now suppresses community-owner rewards and BYOP developer credits when a completed request pushes its payer bucket below zero, while preserving the request charge, negative-balance handling, and credits at an exact zero balance.
gist.impact: Community owners and BYOP developers get credit rewards only from funded requests, with exactly-zero payer balances still qualifying normally.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy billing garden where Polli carefully checks a small lime-green balance meter before placing reward pollen into two labeled jars for a community gardener and a BYOP builder. A completed-request receipt is safely filed nearby, while a code-plant remains healthy, representing unchanged request completion and charges.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike; simple pixel-font text on the meter: "BALANCE 0".
